title: Decision level — design vs operation
body: A design decision authors or parameterizes a configurator: it changes what the system can do (it edits the model). An operation decision runs a configurator in a context: it sets an input and the engine computes the consequence. Design decisions drive operation decisions by context — the design commits the options, tables, and guards an operation decision later runs within.

title: Decision category (the routing key)
body: The category routes a decision to the configurator that `configures` this kind — use-case / technology / network / data-model / process / governance. A requirement of a given kind spawns one decision per relevant dimension, each routed by its own kind. The routing catalogue must be DERIVED from the configurators' own `configures` tags, never hand-listed, or it drifts.

title: A requirement is a configurator (this collection is its degenerate form)
body: A requirement cannot be a row: its acceptance criterion, verification method, and the decisions it triggers are consequences of its category, not values. The full shape adds a primary `kind` choice that reshapes the rest by category (availableWhen), lookup tables, a computed `criterion` (the acceptance predicate that later runs as the verification gate), and `triggers` (the decisions it spawns). Recorded by decision dec-envelope; today's stored fields are the degenerate case until the engine gains choice-gating and a lookup op. See decision dec-selfhost for why this is written in the model, not a spec.

title: Collections are configurators
body: This collection, like every collection, is a Configurator with only stored + computed fields. The general shape adds options-with-availableWhen, lookup tables, validations (errors-as-values), and outputs-with-roles. A design decision that adopted this shape must itself leave the model grounded/typed/homed — the constitution gates the decisions that reshape it.

title: The type lattice, as data (reflective Stage 1)
body: Each domain type is a ROW here — a collection whose members are classes, i.e. an HQDM `class_of_class` (a collection of type type, made literal). This is Stage 1 of the reflective re-base (decision dec-reflective): the metamodel becomes data you can query, render, and home docs on. The reducibility map the engine uses is DERIVED from these rows by the bundle and the gate; the frozen HQDM CORE lattice remains the genesis roots that a type's `specializes` climbs to. One source (these rows); model/types.json is gone.

title: specializes (the isA edges)
body: The parent HQDM classes this type is a subtype of — the specialization (isA) lattice, name-based for now. reduces() climbs CORE ∪ these rows to `thing`. (Enforcing `specializes` as a classification ref, once CORE is itself rows, is a later stage.)
